citations.description: Ticket comment (last, timestamped 1785509530067343001): 'ONE AC NOT SATISFIED … the documented commands have been executed against the J5 harness could not be done on this workstation … This machine is Apple Silicon. That AC needs the native-x86_64 jira-dc-harness CI job, which is where the README says the evidence belongs.'

findings.criterion: `docs/user-guide.md` documents selecting the DC backend and installing the extra, and the documented commands have been executed against the J5 harness
findings.detail: The user-guide.md documentation for selecting the DC backend and installing the extra is present (lines 325–371). However, the sub-requirement that 'the documented commands have been executed against the J5 harness' is not met. The ticket's final comment explicitly states: 'ONE AC NOT SATISFIED … the documented commands have been executed against the J5 harness could not be done on this workstation. The harness README (lines 54-73) documents that the base image is linux/amd64 ONLY … This machine is Apple Silicon.' The harness README confirms a native amd64 runner is a hard requirement. No evidence in the repository demonstrates that the user-guide.md commands were executed against the harness on a qualifying machine; the CI job (jira-dc-harness) runs smoke tests but does not execute the user-guide commands specifically.
findings.remediation: Execute the user-guide.md DC backend commands (pip install, config, JIRA_PAT export, rebar reconcile --dry-run) against the J5 harness on a native x86_64 machine (e.g. via the jira-dc-harness CI job), and record the CI run URL or job output as a ticket comment or artifact to satisfy this criterion.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
